statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Delayed NQ remains rotational inside the session range and off the European-session high; extreme energy, rate and geopolitical Stress has not produced persistent no-retracement structure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the blocking threshold; the concentrated next structure checkpoint is the U.S. cash open through the Dallas Fed release.
headline: NQ rotation keeps Tail at WATCH ahead of the U.S. cash-open and Dallas Fed window
body: Delayed NQ was 29,453.75 at 06:47:02 ET, down 0.13% from the 29,491.75 prior close after a 29,409.75–29,533.75 session range. The retreat from the session high preserves meaningful two-sided price structure. Brent above $90, elevated Treasury yields and renewed U.S.-Iran fighting keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Tail held at 19% through 20:00 UTC on August 30, rose with renewed U.S.-Iran escalation, peaked at 30% at 01:00 UTC, then eased as overnight and European price action rotated. It briefly returned to 26% at 08:00 before settling at 23% in the 09:00 and 10:00 assessments.
outlookSummary: Tail is 22% WATCH because delayed NQ remains inside a broad two-sided range and off the session high. The 13:30–15:30 UTC U.S. cash-open/Dallas Fed window is the next concentrated checkpoint; persistent extension with weak pullbacks would be required for a block, while continued rotation supports easing.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ is 29,453.75 at 06:47 ET after a 29,409.75–29,533.75 range, below the 29,491.75 prior close and well off the session high. The retracement preserves two-sided structure; Tail stays WATCH while oil, yields and geopolitical stress remain extreme.

forecast.analysis: If NQ continues accepting trade away from both session extremes into U.S. premarket hours, repeated rotation would keep Tail near the lower WATCH boundary. A renewed high or low break with shallow counter-moves would invalidate that easing path.

forecast.analysis: As U.S. premarket liquidity deepens, Tail rises conditionally because a range break can seed a more directional cash-open setup. It remains WATCH unless extensions begin surviving meaningful pullbacks.
drivers: Retracement depth before the cash open

forecast.analysis: The U.S. cash open and 14:30 UTC Dallas Fed release form the tightest checkpoint. Tail reaches upper WATCH only if opening-auction direction and subsequent repricing align into repeated extension with weak pullbacks.

After the Dallas Fed release, Tail depends on the observed repricing path. Quick rotation would preserve WATCH, while sustained extension after failed pullbacks would be the condition for a higher band.
If the first ninety minutes of U.S. cash trading remain two-sided, Tail eases further. Persistent near-extreme holding would be the main condition preventing normalization.

news.title: US stock index futures dip as Middle East strikes worsen inflation fears

forecast.analysis: A balanced midday cash session with meaningful counter-moves would keep Tail in WATCH despite elevated background Stress. Repeated extension after failed retracements would be the principal invalidation.
If directional efficiency continues to fade into U.S. afternoon trade, Tail approaches the lower WATCH boundary. A fresh session extreme that holds through pullbacks would keep risk from easing.
Continued two-sided afternoon trade would leave Tail near 20%. A renewed catalyst-driven move would matter primarily if price begins extending repeatedly rather than merely becoming volatile.

news.title: Iran dismisses Trump's post of attack on key energy hub of Kharg

forecast.analysis: The final U.S. cash hour carries a modest conditional Tail lift because late-session flows can reinforce direction. WATCH persists unless a one-way close develops with weak retracement.

After the cash close, Tail falls to low if the session finishes with meaningful rotation rather than sustained extreme holding. Geopolitical and energy risk can keep Stress high even with lower path risk.

news.title: Stocks cautious on US-Iran escalation, bond yields hit multi-year highs

forecast.analysis: If post-close futures remain orderly and counter-moves continue, low Tail is consistent with a recoverable volatile regime. A fresh geopolitical discontinuity would be the main reason to reassess quickly.

Late-evening futures would remain low Tail if the U.S. session's range behavior carries forward. Thin liquidity raises sensitivity to headlines but is not, by itself, evidence of a lethal one-way path.
At the Asia transition, Tail returns to WATCH conditionally because thinner liquidity can amplify any fresh geopolitical move. Without sustained directional extension, the baseline remains two-sided.
drivers: Need for sustained extension to confirm Tail

forecast.analysis: If early Asian trade absorbs headlines with meaningful pullbacks, Tail stays at the lower WATCH boundary. Persistent one-way movement across successive intervals would be the escalation signal.

news.title: Stocks cautious on US-Iran escalation, bond yields hit multi-year highs

forecast.analysis: A contained Asian range would keep Tail near 20% even if Stress remains elevated. Cross-asset confirmation would matter only alongside persistent NQ directional efficiency.
If Asian trading remains rotational through the middle of the session, Tail stays WATCH. A break that repeatedly rejects retracement would be needed for a higher conditional score.
Toward late Asia, sustained two-sided structure would move Tail back to low. Thin-liquidity volatility alone would remain a Stress consideration rather than a Tail trigger.
If the Asia-to-Europe handoff occurs without a persistent breakout, Tail remains low. The next rise would require a directional European setup with shallow pullbacks.
Ahead of the European cash open, Tail returns to WATCH conditionally because liquidity and regional repricing can create a new directional leg. Range preservation would cap that risk.
The European cash open warrants WATCH if overnight structure remains unsettled. Tail would rise only if opening direction persists near an extreme with repeated shallow retracements.

forecast.analysis: If the initial European move retraces meaningfully, Tail remains contained. Sustained extension after failed pullbacks would be the condition for a higher band.
As European trading matures, WATCH reflects the chance that an established regional move carries into the U.S. premarket. Repeated mean reversion would keep the score from rising.

By the final forecast hour, Tail remains WATCH conditionally if Europe has not resolved into a stable range. The next U.S. macro cluster later in the day remains a checkpoint rather than evidence of a future price path.
drivers: Later U.S. macro cluster remains a checkpoint

forecastDetail.comment: Observed delayed NQ remains rotational inside the session range and off the high; Tail is WATCH despite extreme background Stress.
Continued premarket rotation would lower Tail within WATCH; a clean boundary break with shallow counter-moves is the invalidation.
Premarket liquidity raises conditional path risk, but a persistent extension is required before any block threshold.
Cash open plus Dallas Fed is the tightest checkpoint; upper-WATCH Tail requires aligned extension with weak pullbacks.
Post-release Tail depends on actual price discovery: rotation preserves WATCH, while failed pullbacks would raise path risk.
Two-sided first-90-minute cash trade would ease Tail; persistent extreme holding would prevent normalization.
